description: Create comprehensive database indexes for all date-based queries, status filters, foreign key lookups, and composite indexes to speed up Supabase PostgreSQL queries by 10-100x. This involves creating a single SQL file with 40+ CREATE INDEX statements covering all 8 major tables (hospital_daily_records, cdrrmo_daily_operations, bfp_operations, agriculture_damage_reports, water_interruptions, power_interruptions, advisories, reports) plus activity_logs and notifications if they exist.
steps: 1. Create PERFORMANCE_DATABASE_INDEXES.sql in project root with documentation header explaining purpose, execution instructions, and warnings about write performance tradeoffs
2. Add indexes for hospital_daily_records: record_date DESC, hospital_name, composite (record_date DESC, hospital_name)
3. Add indexes for cdrrmo_daily_operations: operation_date DESC, status, operation_type, composite (operation_date DESC, status)
4. Add indexes for bfp_operations: operation_date DESC, status, operation_type, incident_type, composite (operation_date DESC, status)
5. Add indexes for agriculture_damage_reports: report_date DESC, barangay, crop_type, status, category
6. Add indexes for water_interruptions: interruption_date DESC, status, provider, composite (interruption_date DESC, status), GIN index on affected_barangays text field
7. Add indexes for power_interruptions: interruption_date DESC, status, provider, composite (interruption_date DESC, status), GIN index on affected_barangays text field
8. Add indexes for advisories: status, published_at DESC, composite (status, published_at DESC), department_id
9. Add indexes for reports: department_id, status, category, created_at DESC, composite (department_id, status, created_at DESC), user_id
10. Add indexes for activity_logs if table exists: user_id, created_at DESC, composite (user_id, created_at DESC)
11. Add indexes for notifications if table exists: user_id, is_read, created_at DESC, composite (user_id, is_read, created_at DESC)
12. Add monitoring query at end of file to verify index usage via pg_stat_user_indexes
13. Document index rationale in comments: which queries each index optimizes
14. Add EXPLAIN ANALYZE examples showing before/after query plans
15. Create execution instructions: run in Supabase SQL Editor during low-traffic period
acceptance_criteria: PERFORMANCE_DATABASE_INDEXES.sql exists in project root with 40+ CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS statements
File has comprehensive documentation header with execution instructions and rationale
All indexes use IF NOT EXISTS to be safely re-runnable
GIN indexes created for text search on affected_barangays fields
Composite indexes cover common filter combinations (date + status, department + status + date)
Monitoring query included at end to verify index creation and usage
File includes warnings about write performance tradeoffs and recommendations for monitoring
Comments explain which queries each index optimizes (e.g., 'idx_reports_composite optimizes admin dashboard reports filtered by department and status, sorted by date')
verification: Verify PERFORMANCE_DATABASE_INDEXES.sql exists and has 40+ index statements
Read file to confirm all 8 tables covered plus activity_logs and notifications
Execute file in Supabase SQL Editor (note: cannot automate this step, provide instructions)
Run monitoring query from end of file in Supabase SQL Editor to confirm indexes exist
After using admin dashboard, re-run monitoring query to verify times_used > 0 for key indexes
Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on a slow query before and after: verify 'Index Scan' in query plan and 10-100x speedup
